== Summary ==
Before/after image for [[This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further (V)]]: the PC card image of [[This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further (V)]] (2 December 2025, [[:File:V26-D-thisdealisgettingworseallthetime-2025-12-02.png|V26-D-thisdealisgettingworseallthetime-2025-12-02.png]], scaled to the slip height) beside the slip of the [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata] (page 2). Made from the two published images (Bill, 12 November 2026). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260428005738/https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf Internet Archive].
